delta_from_prior: Replaces the disjoint-pair product structure of Neon58 and neon_worstcase_auto_00161 (which have twin variables and pathwidth-1 pair-transversal quotients vulnerable to Fable73's paired branching order and proposed link-twin contraction) with a lifted, strictly minimal-UNSAT, twin-free, kernel-free hypergraph-transversal contradiction Phi(G_11, P_6) (19 vars, 136 clauses -> exact BLQ quotient 17 vars, 74 clauses). Every vertex in both G_11 and the 6-vertex Pasch 3-uniform hypergraph P_6 has a unique incident-edge signature (zero twins, no Cartesian-product structure), while width-5 cross clauses and width-6/7 left clauses suppress IALH-5 window blowup. Also explicitly acknowledges the Neon54/55 K6 near-parity falsification and confirms v5 soundness via direct code audit.
explanation:
### 1. Code Audit of Pinned v5 (`blq-composed-core-scc-emra-ialh5-v5`)
Auditing the supplied v5 solver, `compression.py`, `core_refutation.py`, and pinned SCC/DP/MRA dependencies finds **no soundness bug** (no `correctness_fixture`):
- **Original-clause coverage (`compression.py`)**: `_verify_certificate` maps `formula` via `dense_formula(formula, ids)` and populates `blocks` from every clause of `original`, rejecting duplicate-variable clauses and enforcing `len(counts) == len(blocks)` and `sum(counts) == len(quotient)`. For every block `(support, clauses)`, it checks `forms[i] & ~mask == 0` for all quotient coordinates `i` used in that block's slice `q`, and checks `evaluate(clauses, x) == evaluate(q, image)` on all `2**len(support)` local assignments. Because `P * L = I_r` over GF(2) is verified entrywise (`parity(form & column) == int(i == j)`), projection is surjective and `original` is equisatisfiable with `quotient`.
- **Composed core refutation (`core_refutation.py`, `run_counting`)**: `probe` independently enforces `set(core).issubset(set(f))`, compresses `core` via `compress_root`, and returns `UNSAT` only when the quotient is 2-CNF and `two_sat(q)` is false. Applying `probe` once to an accepted exact quotient preserves soundness by exact equisatisfiability.
- **Residual solver (`refute`, `canon_plus`, `elim_plus`, `prune`)**: `up_survives` uses unit propagation only, `verify_certificate` independently checks every local lattice row and rational dual `uA in Z`, `ub not in Z`, `signed_scc` enforces skew-symmetry, `elim` applies sound Davis-Putnam resolution, and `prune` drops `g` only when `below(g, h)` (so `models(g) <= models(h)`).

I also acknowledge the receipt falsifying Neon54/55: width-5 UP tables retain XOR congruences even after deleting a satisfying point, and the global lattice combines rows across windows, giving peak 0.

### 2. New Growth Fixture: Twin-Free, Kernel-Free Lifted Hypergraph-Cover Contradiction `Phi(G_11, P_6)`
Both Neon58 and `neon_worstcase_auto_00161` compress to bipartite **disjoint-pair** transversal contradictions, where each pair `(a_i, b_i)` forms a twin pair in the positive cross clauses and a Cartesian product in the negative clauses—allowing Fable73's paired variable order to reduce Neon58 from peak 8 to 2 and motivating Fable73's proposed link-twin contraction.

This fixture eliminates all twins and product structure by pairing a connected 11-vertex graph `G_11` with the 6-vertex 3-uniform Pasch hypergraph `P_6`, then lifting two `P_6` variables by XOR pairs so exact BLQ root compression succeeds:
- **Left graph `G_11` (variables `1..11`, 11 edges)**: independent set `X={1,2,3,4}` matched to `Y_1={5,6,7,8}` via `(1,5),(2,6),(3,7),(4,8)`; triangle `Y_2={9,10,11}` with `(9,10),(10,11),(9,11)`; and connecting edges `(5,9),(6,10),(7,11),(8,9)`. All 11 vertices have distinct neighborhoods (zero twins). Its 23 minimal vertex covers (MVCs) give 23 negative clauses of width 6 (20 clauses) and width 7 (3 clauses), forcing at least one edge of `G_11` to be all-0.
- **Right hypergraph `P_6` (quotient variables `12..17`, 4 triples)**: `e1={12,13,14}`, `e2={12,15,16}`, `e3={13,15,17}`, `e4={14,16,17}`. Every vertex is the unique intersection of a distinct pair of triples (zero twins). Its 7 minimal hitting sets give 3 binary negative clauses (`[-12,-17], [-13,-16], [-14,-15]`) and 4 ternary negative clauses (`[-12,-13,-14], [-12,-15,-16], [-13,-15,-17], [-14,-16,-17]`), forcing at least one triple of `P_6` to be all-0.
- **Cross clauses**: all `11 * 4 = 44` positive 5-clauses `e U f` for `e in E(G_11)` and `f in F(P_6)`. Since some `e` is all-0 and some `f` is all-0, `Phi(G_11, P_6)` is **UNSAT**.
- **Strict minimal UNSAT (nearby SAT controls)**: deleting any MVC of `G_11` is satisfied by setting that MVC to 1 (covering all edges of `G_11`) and `P_6` to 0; deleting any MVC of `P_6` is symmetric; deleting any cross clause `(e, f)` is satisfied by setting `e` and `f` to 0 and all other vertices to 1. Thus every proper subformula of the 74-clause quotient is SAT.
- **Exact BLQ lifting (19 vars, 136 clauses, max width 7)**: replace `q16 = 16 XOR 18` and `q17 = 17 XOR 19` in the `P_6` and cross clauses. This produces 23 `G_11` clauses + 14 lifted `P_6` clauses + 99 lifted cross clauses = 136 clauses, `sum(2**len(s)) = 4924 <= 16384`, max block width `7 <= 8`.

### 3. Expected Behavior on Pinned v5 (Discovery vs. Residual Growth)
- **Root compression succeeds (not a skip)**: `1..15` are in odd-sized blocks; `{16,18}` and `{17,19}` have stabilizers `e_16^e_18` and `e_17^e_19`. `compress_root` finds the exact 17-form compatible basis `{e_1..e_15, e_16^e_18, e_17^e_19}` with exact GF(2) right inverse and reduces 19 vars / 136 clauses to 17 vars / 74 clauses (`Phi(G_11, P_6)`).
- **Composed core refutation returns `UNKNOWN`**: every block of the 136-clause input is already a complete stabilizer coset (size 1, 2, or 4), and every block of the 74-clause quotient has size 1, so `probe` removes 0 clauses at both stages (`no_clauses_removed`). Moreover, no proper core of the quotient can be UNSAT.
- **Residual growth under ascending quotient order**: `compression.py` sorts chosen forms by descending block count, then popcount: `9` (35 blocks), `10` (27), `11` (27), `12,13,14,15` (25, popcount 1), `q16,q17` (25, popcount 2), then `Y_1` and `X`.
  - All 23 `G_11` MVCs have width `6-7 > 5` and all 44 cross clauses have width 5 (zero pair-unions `<= 5`), keeping root IALH-5 windows small (~58) and local UP tables full-rank over `Z`. Since `|V(P_6)| = 6 > 5`, no width-5 window contains `P_6`.
  - Branching on `{9,10,11}` leaves 4 pairwise-incomparable surviving states (`(1,1,0)`, `(1,0,1)`, `(0,1,1)`, `(1,1,1)`), each with `p*q > p+q` on all remaining active variables.
  - Branching on `12` splits each of the 4 states into 2 incomparable states (`12=0` vs `12=1` with `q17=0`), reaching at least **8** simultaneous states at layer 4, and branching on `13` splits further to **>= 8–12** simultaneous states while keeping `P_6`-eliminated branches tiny for fast completion.

### 4. Scope
This is a concrete finite UNSAT growth fixture testing v5's residual search beyond twin-pair products; it is not an asymptotic lower bound without a parameterized proof.
